variants.prompt: On the expansive deck of a sleek, black yacht, a vivacious young woman with raven-black, curly locks and piercing emerald eyes, exudes confidence in a skintight, burgundy leather bodysuit. Her creamy, sun-kissed skin seems to glow under the warm setting sun. She leans against the polished rail, one stiletto-clad foot propped up, as a gentle sea breeze tousles her locks. The camera, a high-end DSLR, captures her in a sensual wide shot with a shallow depth of field, emphasizing her curves and the blurred ocean backdrop.
